title: ResearchBoost-Agent · 训练代码自动加速与数值验证

description.zh: 面向真实 AI 训练代码的 Agent 优化工作流：先冻结基线工作负载和评测规则，再让 Codex/Claude Code 分析性能瓶颈、修改代码、测量加速，并检查结构、数值轨迹与端到端结果。附有训练优化 Skills、任务模板与上游作者报告的案例；本站尚未独立运行验证。
description.en: An agent-driven workflow for optimizing real AI training code. It freezes the baseline workload and judge before Codex/Claude Code profiles, edits, times and validates candidates, with training optimization skills, task templates and upstream-reported case studies. Not independently reproduced by this catalog.

zh: 已有可运行的模型训练或评测仓库，希望在不改变科学任务定义的前提下优化 GPU 时间。
愿意先固定训练命令、数据、精度约束、对照实验和验收规则，再允许 Agent 改动训练实现。
en: You have a runnable model training/evaluation repository and want to reduce GPU time without changing the scientific workload.
You can freeze commands, data, numerical constraints, controls and acceptance rules before allowing code edits.

zh: 用 Codex 或 Claude Code 在 Linux GPU 主机上启动；先由 Formulator 检查代码、GPU、训练负载和数值约束，搭建基线与冻结的 bench/judge。
优化会话按 Profile → 修改 → 计时 → 数值检查 → 记录循环进行；使用独立监督和可恢复会话。
正式验收检查结构/数据等价、真实加速收益、逐位一致性或多随机种子统计轨迹；最后用真实端到端训练或评测复核。
en: Start Codex or Claude Code on a Linux GPU host; let the formulator inspect the repository, GPUs, workload and numeric constraints, then freeze baseline and judge.
Use the profile → edit → time → validate → log loop with separate supervision and resumable sessions.
Accept only after structure/data checks, measured speedup, bitwise or paired-seed trajectory checks, and a real end-to-end run.

zh: 上游 README 报告跨 12 个项目、5 个领域的加速结果，不能作为本站独立复现或任意项目的性能保证。
短轨迹等价性无法证明长时间训练收敛、最终精度完全相同；仅测稳态 step-time 也不能覆盖启动与预处理成本。
bubblewrap 不可用时会退化为直连模式，失去文件系统隔离；不要在未经审计的敏感训练环境中直接开放修改权限。
当前根目录未见统一 LICENSE；复制代码、改编或二次分发前核对各文件及依赖的授权。
en: Upstream reports 12 projects across five domains; these are not independent reproductions or universal speedup guarantees.
Short trajectory agreement cannot prove identical long-run convergence; steady-state step timing excludes some setup and preprocessing costs.
Without bubblewrap the runner may fall back to direct mode without filesystem isolation; review permissions before use on sensitive hosts.
No top-level LICENSE was found at review; inspect per-file and dependency licenses before reuse.

zh: 可运行的训练仓库、基线命令、数据/权重位置、GPU 预算、训练精度与不可修改约束。
en: Runnable training repository and baseline command, data/weights, GPU budget, precision and non-negotiable constraints.

zh: 候选优化代码与开关、性能分析、固定评测报告 check.json、迭代日志 WORK_LOG.md 和最终验收结论。
en: Optimized candidate with switches, profiles, frozen-judge check.json, WORK_LOG.md iterations and a final acceptance verdict.

zh: Linux + NVIDIA GPU；可用的 Codex 或 Claude Code；可访问训练环境/权重/数据；claw-orchestrator；建议安装 bubblewrap 用于隔离（缺失时需审查直接模式风险）。
en: Linux with NVIDIA GPUs, Codex or Claude Code access, workload dependencies/assets, claw-orchestrator; bubblewrap recommended for isolation (review direct-mode risks).

zh: 在训练仓库启动 Codex/Claude Code，粘贴：用 ResearchBoost-Agent（https://github.com/AI4AI-for-Anything/ResearchBoost-Agent）加速我的训练。把它克隆到我的仓库之外，从 goal/templates/FORMULATOR_BRIEF.md 第 0.5 节开始执行。
确认训练命令、GPU 分配、基线精度和哪些参数必须保持一致；先由 Agent 构建并冻结评测器。
只在独立工作区执行优化循环，审查候选修改与可恢复的执行记录。
要求完整 bench.py check 通过，再跑真实端到端任务确认收益。
en: In your training repository, ask Codex/Claude Code to clone ResearchBoost-Agent outside your repository and follow goal/templates/FORMULATOR_BRIEF.md §0.5.
Confirm training command, GPU allocation, baseline precision and immutable constraints; freeze the evaluator first.
Run optimization in a separate workspace and inspect candidate diffs and resumable logs.
Require a full bench.py check and independently rerun the real end-to-end workload.

zh: 固定评测器哈希与训练入口，确认同一工作负载且基线无漂移；拒绝通过减少训练步骤、改变同步或破坏梯度制造的假加速。
核实 Gate 0 结构 → Gate 1 真实收益 → Gate 2 逐位 → Gate 3 配对随机种子统计等价；数值容差 δ 必须在候选评测前冻结。
跟踪总 GPU-hours、最终训练效果、稳态/端到端成本差异，明确上游案例与本站验证的区别。
en: Freeze judge hash and workload; reject fake gains from fewer steps, changed synchronization or broken gradients.
Check Gate 0 structure → Gate 1 benefit → Gate 2 bitwise → Gate 3 paired-seed statistical equivalence, with δ fixed before judging candidates.
Track GPU-hours, final training outcome and step-time versus end-to-end cost; separate upstream claims from local evidence.

selection_reason.zh: 针对训练代码加速提供可执行的 Agent 优化闭环与冻结数值验证；171 Stars 为当日上游仓库关注量快照，不是效果证明，早期项目的真实普及程度仍待观察。
selection_reason.en: Provides an actionable agent optimization loop and frozen numerical checks for training code. The 171 GitHub stars are a dated repository snapshot, not evidence of performance or widespread adoption.

alt.zh: ResearchBoost-Agent 的四阶段工作流：定义任务、冻结评测器、Agent 循环优化、独立完整验收。
alt.en: The four-stage ResearchBoost-Agent workflow: task formulation, frozen judge, agent optimization loop and independent final acceptance.
